lines.trans: Nina, in fact nobody robbed me.
And why did you say nothing to me right away?
I was very much afraid that you would leave.
Why did you hide the truth from your wife?
I felt very ashamed in front of you, Nina.
I would never have walked away from you anywhere!
Will you truly stay with me after this?
We have lived together in the communal flat for so many years.
I promise to return all the lost money back.
The main thing is that you always tell me the truth.
Thank you very much for your forgiveness and love.
Let's go drink tea, we will handle everything.

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
I'm with my wife this evening.
I live in a communal flat.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: colloquial for коммунальная квартира: one flat shared by several families

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
We live in a communal flat.

meanings.note: fleeting vowel о drops in genitive/dative/prepositional (любви), kept in instrumental (любовью)

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!
examples.trans: Marina, listen, it's all because of love!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
+ dative of the person: обещать вам

examples.trans: Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.

meanings.note: used on its own: он пьёт = he drinks

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness, apologise

examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: to keep from sight or knowledge
спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

справиться.gloss: to manage, to cope, to handle

meanings.note: often + с + instrumental, or used absolutely

examples.text: Мы за два года тут не справимся.
examples.trans: We won't manage here in two years.
You can see it at once.
There are so many mistakes there!
I don't have that much time.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away, to walk out

meanings.note: partitive genitive чаю is common: чашка чаю

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
I'm calling to say thank you.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
